2. The facts relevant for disposal of the present petition are that the writ respondent Uttara Bank Ltd, obtained a money decree against the writ petitioners and put that money decree into execution in the Artha Execution Case No. 9 of 2006. In that execution case, at one stage, on the prayer of the decree holder bank, the Adalat issued warrant of arrest against the judgment debtor-petitioners under section 34 of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 for the purpose of compelling them to pay the decretal amount. 

 8. It appears from the judgment of the High Court Division that the submissions made before us were also made before that Division and have been elaborately dealt with in the impugned judgment. The High Court Division' observed that there was no requirement under provisions of the Artha Rin Adalat Ain, 2003 to issue show cause notice and that the provisions of Order XXI of the Code are applicable in execution cases where the prayer is for execution of a money decree.
